31792-A.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2008, adjusting appropriations and receipts across infrastructure categories following the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no new powers for the executive; it sets the amended budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date.
31792-A.j: The memorandum justifies the lower spending by unused risk reserves for large projects and delayed payments on Spoorse Doorsnijdingen and Nationale Sleutelprojecten Utrecht, not by any grant of new power.
q: No further recourse was made to the risk reserve for large projects in 2008 (€70 million).
Op de risicoreservering voor grote projecten is in 2008 geen verder beroep gedaan (€ 70 mln.).

31924-D.s: This bill is the final budget adjustment act (slotwet) for the Fonds economische structuurversterking for 2008, setting realised spending and revenue figures and the resulting balance. It amends the 2008 budget statement, with the amounts stated in thousands of euros and effect from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
31924-D.j: The memorandum explains that spending lagged behind estimates because the start dates and durations of approved projects were later than planned, for example in education-entrepreneurship and vocational-education projects.
q: The delay is caused by the start date and duration of the approved projects;
De vertraging is veroorzaakt door de startdatum en looptijd van de goedgekeurde projecten;

32360-I.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (slotwet) for the Household of the Queen for fiscal year 2009, adjusting the budget statement to realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and enters into force the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
32360-I.j: The explanatory memorandum attributes the small deviation from the budget to wage and price developments differing from assumptions; it does not justify any new powers.
q: Because wage and price developments deviate somewhat from what was assumed when the budget was drawn up, the total amount deviates slightly from the budgeted amount.
Doordat de loon- en prijsontwikkeling enigszins afwijkt van datgene waarmee bij het opstellen van de begroting rekening is gehouden, wijkt het totaalbedrag beperkt af van het bedrag dat is begroot.

32360-XVIII.s: This Dutch budget bill (Slotwet 2009, Wonen, Wijken en Integratie) sets the final budget mutations and realised expenditure and revenue figures for the housing, neighbourhoods and integration chapter for 2009. It also relaxes certain annual report requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for that chapter's jaarverslag.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the annual report of the Wonen, Wijken en Integratie chapter for 2009 may limit the per-policy-article information in the explanatory notes to items c through f of that paragraph.

In afwijking van artikel 54, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 geldt voor het jaarverslag van het begrotingshoofdstuk Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2009 dat het in dat artikellid bedoelde inzicht per beleidsartikel in de toelichting bij de verantwoordingsstaat beperkt kan blijven tot de onderdelen c tot en met f van dat artikellid.

32395-A.s: The bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund, shifting appropriations and receipts across infrastructure articles as set out in the first supplementary budget. It enters into force on 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2010
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2010

32565-B.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting revised commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants and specifying the budget table in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the budget statement belonging to this act.
Artikel 1 De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

32780-C.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting new commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting the expenditure and revenue lines by a total of about 35 million euros. It takes effect 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have deemed and resolved ... The budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for the year 2011 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd

33605-F.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adopting a supplementary budget and closing account, with figures in thousands of euros effective from the day after publication. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34085-C.s: The bill amends the 2014 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting new commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants and adjusting expenditure and revenue lines. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for 2014 is amended as shown in the attached budget schedule.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden ... de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd

34350-H.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the BES-fonds (H), increasing its appropriations and receipts by a second supplementary budget. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the law enters into force on 1 December 2015, retroactively if published later.
q: We have considered that a change to the 2015 budget statement of the BES-fonds (H) has proven necessary.
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2015.

34475-XVII.s: This slotwet amends the 2015 departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), adjusting appropriations and commitments across its policy articles to reflect realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after its gazette publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
34475-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, which require explanation of significant differences between estimates; it does not justify any delegation.
q: In accordance with the State Budget Regulations and the 2001 Accounting Act, notable differences between the previous (Second Supplementary Budget) and current estimate must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de vorige (Tweede Suppletoire Begroting) en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

34725-B.s: This Slotwet adjusts the 2016 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), fixing the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants and setting the final budget statement with realised figures. It enters into force the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
34725-B.j: The memorandum explains the budget difference of EUR 4,876,000 by the non-final allocation factor and differences between estimated and actual distribution criteria, without justifying any new powers.
q: as long as the allocation factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

34950-B.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures and sets the 2017 commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This concerns a difference of € 13,845,000. The reason for the difference is that, as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget.

Het gaat hierbij om een verschil van € 13.845.000. De reden van het verschil ligt in het feit dat zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat.

34960-A.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Eerste suppletoire begroting), changing expenditure, commitment and revenue figures for articles on motorways, railways, regional infrastructure, waterways and megaprojects, effective from 1 June 2018. The accompanying memorandum lists project-level budget and cash adjustments for integrated contracts on the main road network and for rail passenger transport realisation programmes.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

35095-A.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget schedule (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project items. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force at 1 December 2018 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget schedule of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2018.
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2018.

35570-C.s: This bill fixes the 2021 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at 2,483,429 thousand euros, including commitment amounts for the general grant and integration/decentralisation grants. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2021 or retroactively from that date if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant is fixed for grant year 2021 at € 2,367,664,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2021 vastgesteld op € 2.367.664.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 provinciefonds budget bill (C) without remarks and recommends submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Financiën's nader rapport confirms the Afdeling has no objections to the 2021 budget bills, noting one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Financiën budget that is addressed in an annex.

35850-B.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment and expenditure figures by about 938 million euro. It sets the 2021 commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and for the integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet, and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: Amendment of the 2021 budget statement of the municipal fund
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2021

36120-K.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (DMF) by raising expenditure authorisations by EUR 602.1 million and revenue by EUR 912.5 million, as a first supplementary budget. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes mainly to project delays, rephasing of procurement and maintenance programmes, and small revenue deviations.
36120-K.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by pointing to project delays, rephasing from the Defence Lifecycle Plan, and reporting to parliament via the Defence Projects Overview.
q: With this bill it is proposed to increase the 2022 expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) compared with the adopted budget by EUR 602.1 million

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld de uitgavenbegroting 2022 van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) ten opzichte van de vastgestelde begroting met een bedrag van € 602,1 miljoen te verhogen

36200-L.s: The bill sets the 2023 budget statement for the Nationaal Groeifonds (National Growth Fund) as a begrotingsfonds, totalling about 8.57 billion euro in commitments and 1.57 billion euro in expenditure and receipts for the knowledge and R&D investment articles. The explanatory memorandum explains the conversion from a non-departmental budget to a budget fund and the allocation of projects to ministries.
36200-L.j: The memorandum justifies the budget-fund format by meeting the wishes of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer and parliament, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: With this, the wishes of the Council of State's advisory division, the Court of Audit and parliament have been met.
Hiermee is tegemoet gekomen aan de wensen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer (Kamerstuk 35 570, nr. 3 ) en het parlement.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Nationaal Groeifonds and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport transmits the Raad's blanket advice on the 2023 budget bills and attaches amendments to several budgets, without addressing any substantive legal objections.

36410-I.s: This bill formally adopts the 2024 budget statement for the Dutch Crown (the King's household), setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros for the grondwettelijke uitkeringen to royal family members and the functional costs of the King as head of state. The explanatory memorandum details the budget items, indexation of the allowances, and existing controls, without delegating new rule-making powers.
q: Article 1: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2024 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 11 September 2023 that it had no remarks on the draft 2024 budget bill (Begrotingsstaten 2024) for De Koning and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The text consists of a transmittal of multiple advisory opinions on the 2024 budget bills and funds, and no government reply with remarks is presented.

36435-B.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general and additional allocations, integration allocations and decentralisation allocations for 2023. It enters into force on 19 September 2023 or the day after publication if later, with retroactive effect.
q: Is amended as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36470-C.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amount for the general grant to EUR 3,050,517,000 and the decentralisation grants to EUR 79,808,000. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2023;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2023;

36560-C.s: This bill adjusts the 2023 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) through a closing budget law, setting the commitment amount for the general grant at €3,050,517,000 and the decentralisation grants at €79,808,000. It also records the final figures for budget supplements and realisations, with a retroactive effective date of 31 December of the budget year.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant is set for grant year 2023 at €3,050,517,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2023 vastgesteld op € 3.050.517.000.

36625-A.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat, adjusting spending, commitments and receipts across infrastructure articles in thousands of euros. It sets the amended statement's effective date to one day after gazetting, retroactive to 1 December 2024.
36625-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by stating that a planned Basisnet acquisition did not proceed this year, so the reserved External Safety budget carries over to 2025.
q: This article item is reduced by € 3.4 million because no use is made this year of the reserved External Safety budget for the Basisnet acquisition process.
Dit artikelonderdeel wordt verlaagd met € 3,4 miljoen omdat er dit jaar geen beroep wordt gedaan op het gereserveerde budget voor Externe Veiligheid ten behoeve van het Aankooptraject Basisnet.

36725-XVII.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2025 state budget for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across five policy articles with net increases in several lines. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes to ODA budget indexation, a government-wide cut on wage and price adjustments, and the phasing out of vocational and higher education projects.
36725-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to ODA indexation to GNI growth and a Rijksbrede cut on wage and price adjustments, with no delegation of powers.

36740-C.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Provinciefonds (provincial fund) by adjusting appropriations and receipts through supplementary budgets and the final closing law. It sets the general grant commitment at €3,554,618,000 and the decentralisation grant commitment at €399,727,000 for 2024, and takes effect the day after publication.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Provinciefonds (C) for the year 2024 (closing law)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds (C) voor het jaar 2024 (slotwet)

36850-A.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and mega-project infrastructure items. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2025.
36850-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by referring to higher expected subsidy requests, reallocated housing-development funds, border-control compensation and the 2025 balance, without delegating new powers.
q: This is the result of processing the 2025 balance (- EUR 21.5 million), HXII: repayment of TVOV funds (EUR 6 million), compensation for border controls (- EUR 5 million)
Dit is het resultaat van de verwerking van het Saldo 2025 (- € 21,5 miljoen), HXII: terugstorting TVOV-middelen (€ 6 miljoen), compensatie grenscontroles (- € 5 miljoen)
